headline.purpose: The single h1 each screen owns; min(30px, 12vw) on solo pages.

title.purpose: Product name, attention banner title, section headings.

body.purpose: All running text, inputs and sidebar nav; 17px, tabular numbers.

label.purpose: Buttons, storage label, banner detail, field labels.

label-xs.purpose: Bottom tab labels, capped at min(13px, 5vw), never wrapping.

code.purpose: IBM Plex Mono 600, the pairing code only, so I/l/1 and 0/O can't be confused. A scoped exception to the single-typeface rule.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every focusable element; never removed.

shadows.name: attention-border
shadows.purpose: The attention banner card's amber border.

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: What genuinely floats or lifts: the Photos select bar (sticky above 720px), dialogs, the scrubber's date pill and its phone grip, and a photo tile on mouse hover. Never a card at rest.

shadows.name: dialog-backdrop
shadows.purpose: Dims the page behind a modal dialog (ink at 45%).

shadows.name: choice-checked
shadows.purpose: With an ink border, the chosen radio choice row's 2px ink edge.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover fills on buttons, nav and More links; the scrubber grip growing while dragged and its date pill fading in; 0ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Safety banner material change; a checked tile's photo shrinking to 88%; the tile hover lift and greying; dialog-in; the phone scrubber handle fading; an album cover greying on hover; 0ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.value: from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) } over duration-base, ease-out

motion.name: tile-lift
motion.purpose: Photo tile on mouse hover (hover: hover only). The lift is dropped under reduced motion; the greying stays.

breakpoints.name: sidebar
breakpoints.purpose: Above: sticky 264px sidebar. At or below 720px: four fixed bottom tabs, 72px tall plus safe-area inset. Photos: tile sizes aim for 180/120/80px above, 110/80/56px at or below; the scrubber is a 3.5rem column above and a lone fixed handle at or below; select bar sticky only above; viewer puts the photo first at or below; dialogs become bottom sheets at or below. Albums: shelf columns of at least 12.5rem above, min(100%, 9rem) at or below (two across, one at 200% text). Dialogs take 16px inline padding at or below.

breakpoints.name: viewer-details
breakpoints.purpose: Viewer with Details open: details become a 20rem column beside the photo.

breakpoints.name: word-card-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Recovery key card: when one column is this narrow, each number moves above its word.

breakpoints.name: print
breakpoints.purpose: Prints the recovery key card alone on one sheet (18mm margins, 3 columns); everything else display: none.

breakpoints.name: dialog-cover-hide
breakpoints.purpose: Album picker rows and the move confirm: covers hide so the words keep the room at large text in a narrow dialog.

sizes.name: tile-days
sizes.value: aims for 180px / 110px at or below 720px; at least 3 columns

sizes.name: tile-months
sizes.value: aims for 120px / 80px at or below 720px; at least 4 columns

sizes.name: tile-years
sizes.value: aims for 80px / 56px at or below 720px; at least 6 columns

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The screen's one primary action, in its header row right of the h1.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">Upload</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d5d6d2); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #16181b); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary { border-color: var(--color-safe, #2e7d5b); background: var(--color-safe, #2e7d5b); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-safe-strong, #1f5a41); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Any non-primary action.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary">Cancel</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d5d6d2); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #16181b); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-sunk, #f2f2ef); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; }

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Move to Trash: firm and reversible, so dark ink, never red (owner, 2026-11-04).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ink">Move to Trash</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #16181b); background: var(--color-ink, #16181b); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-3, #4a4e54); background: var(--color-ink-3, #4a4e54); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; }

components.name: Quiet Danger Button
components.description: Where permanent deletion is offered (Delete forever on a Trash row, Empty Trash): red words on white. Always opens a confirm.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-qd"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7h16"/><path d="M10 11v6"/><path d="M14 11v6"/><path d="M6 7l1 12a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h6a2 2 0 0 0 2-2l1-12"/><path d="M9 7V4h6v3"/></svg>Empty Trash</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-qd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d5d6d2); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-danger, #b3261e); } .ds-btn-qd svg { flex: none; } .ds-btn-qd:hover { background: var(--color-surface-sunk, #f2f2ef); } .ds-btn-qd:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Red fill only on the final confirm of a permanent deletion (Delete forever in the confirm dialog).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-danger">Delete forever</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-danger, #b3261e); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-danger, #b3261e); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labelled field, 48px tall, label above.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Box address<input class="ds-input" value="cloudbox.local"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink, #16181b); } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d5d6d2); border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400; color: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1f5a41; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Above 720px: four rows; the active row (aria-current page, or true for a page under it, e.g. Albums on /trash) has a green tint; Box carries the attention dot in attention states only.
components.html: PhotosAlbumsBox
components.css: .ds-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 232px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-side-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 14px; color: #16181b; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-side-link:hover { background: #f2f2ef; } .ds-side-link[aria-current] { background: #e6f1eb; color: #1f5a41; font-weight: 700; } .ds-side-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; } .ds-glyph { position: relative; display: flex; } .ds-dot { position: absolute; top: -4px; right: -4px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e0a33a; border: 2px solid #fff; box-sizing: border-box; }

components.name: Bottom Tabs
components.description: At or below 720px: four fixed tabs, icon over label, a green-tint pill behind the active icon.
components.html: PhotosAlbumsFilesBox
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); min-height: 72px; width: 360px; background: #fff; border-top: 1px solid #e4e4e0; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 48px; padding: 6px 0; color: #5c6066; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab-icon { box-sizing: content-box; padding: 2px 14px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] { color: #1f5a41; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] .ds-tab-icon { background: #e6f1eb; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #1f5a41; }

components.name: Safety Banner: Safe
components.description: Signature. Green-tint strip, shield-check icon, title and last backup time. Only when the box reports safe.
components.html: Everything is safeBackup copy updated 4 min ago
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 14px; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-banner svg { flex: none; } .ds-banner-text { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; column-gap: 8px; row-gap: 2px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-banner-title { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-banner-safe { background: #e6f1eb; color: #1f4a38; } .ds-banner-safe .ds-banner-detail { color: #3f5f51; } .ds-banner:hover { filter: saturate(1.15) brightness(0.98); } .ds-banner:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; }

components.name: Safety Banner: Copying
components.description: White strip, full ink, shield-sync icon, a count waiting for the backup copy. Never green.
components.html: 37 waiting for the backup copyThey're on your box. The backup copy runs every hour.
components.css: .ds-banner-c { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: #16181b; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-banner-c svg { flex: none; } .ds-banner-c-text { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; column-gap: 8px; row-gap: 2px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-banner-c-title { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-banner-c-detail { color: #5c6066; }

components.name: Safety Banner: Attention
components.description: Amber bordered card that grows to hold the reason and what to do. Paused, almost full, unreachable.
components.html: Backup copy pausedThe backup drive isn't connected. Your photos are on the main drive only.
components.css: .ds-banner-a { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 18px; background: #fbf0d9; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #e0a33a; color: #4a3200; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: padding 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-radius 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-banner-a svg { flex: none; } .ds-banner-a-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; row-gap: 2px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-banner-a-title { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; color: #3b2800; } .ds-banner-a:hover { filter: saturate(1.15) brightness(0.98); } .ds-banner-a:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #e0a33a, 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; }

components.name: Storage Card
components.description: Sidebar card under the nav: used of size, with a pill meter. Hidden when status is unknown or unreachable.
components.html: 412 GB of 1 TB used
components.css: .ds-storage { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 232px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); color: #16181b; } .ds-storage-label { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-meter { height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e2e2de; overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter-fill { width: 41%; height: 100%; background: #2e7d5b; }

components.name: Field with Hint and Error
components.description: Label, hint, input, error. Hint and error tied by aria-describedby; the error stays until the field changes. Error colour is an open question (see DESIGN.md Colors).
components.html:
At least 10 characters. A few words you will remember works well.

Use at least 10 characters.
components.css: .ds-ff { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 340px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--color-ink, #16181b); } .ds-ff label { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-ff-hint { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-ink-2, #5c6066); } .ds-ff-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d5d6d2); border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 17px; } .ds-ff-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--color-danger, #b3261e); } .ds-ff-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; border-color: #1f5a41; } .ds-ff-error { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-danger, #b3261e); } .ds-ff-error svg { flex: none; margin-top: 1px; }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Ink on white with a hairline border and a warning icon; the warning variant is semibold. Never amber.
components.html: This signs out every phone and computer connected to your box. You'll need to add them again.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; width: 380px; margin: 0; padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-line-strong, #d5d6d2); color: var(--color-ink, #16181b); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-notice svg { flex: none; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-notice-warning { font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Entry Action Row
components.description: Primary first, then Back, then the quiet step line at the row's end. Never an eyebrow above the h1.
components.html: Step 2 of 5
components.css: .ds-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 480px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-a-primary, .ds-a-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-a-primary { border: 1px solid #2e7d5b; background: var(--color-safe, #2e7d5b); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; } .ds-a-primary:hover { background: var(--color-safe-strong, #1f5a41); } .ds-a-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d5d6d2); background: #fff; color: #16181b; font-weight: 600; } .ds-a-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-sunk, #f2f2ef); } .ds-a-primary:focus-visible, .ds-a-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #1f5a41; } .ds-step { margin: 0 0 0 auto; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-ink-2, #5c6066); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Recovery Key Card
components.description: Signature. The one white card in setup: 24 numbered words, 3 columns on desktop, 2 on phones, 1 at 200% text; a word never splits. Prints alone.
components.html:
Write these words down, in order

  1. 1harbor
  2. 2maple
  3. 3quiet
  4. 4lantern
  5. 5orbit
  6. 6velvet
  7. 7cactus
  8. 8ember
  9. 9glide
  10. 10pocket
  11. 11tundra
  12. 12willow

Keep them on paper somewhere safe at home. Don't save them in a photo or an email.
components.css: .ds-rk { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; width: 480px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #16181b); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); container-type: inline-size; } .ds-rk-title { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-rk-words { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 8em), 1fr)); gap: 12px 20px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-rk-words li { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-rk-num { min-width: 1.6em; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-ink-2, #5c6066); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: end; } .ds-rk-word { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-rk-keep { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-ink-2, #5c6066); } @container (max-width: 17rem) { .ds-rk-words li { flex-direction: column; gap: 0; } .ds-rk-num { min-width: 0; text-align: start; } }

components.name: Device List
components.description: Box section card: one row per device, hairline-divided, with a 'This browser' pill badge and a Last seen line.
components.html:
Devices

  • Chrome on LinuxThis browserLast seen just now
  • Safari on iPhoneLast seen 2 days ago
components.css: .ds-dev { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; width: 360px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; color: #16181b; font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-dev h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-dev-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-dev-list li { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e4e0); } .ds-dev-list li:first-child { border-top: 0; padding-top: 0; } .ds-dev-name { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-dev-this { padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface-sunk, #f2f2ef); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dev-seen { flex-basis: 100%; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-ink-2, #5c6066); }

components.name: Pairing Code
components.description: Sunk panel with the single-use code in IBM Plex Mono, groups of four that never split, and when it expires.
components.html:
Pairing code

K7QM R2XW 9HTB 4NCP

Valid until 14:30. It works once.
components.css: .ds-pair { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 320px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-surface-sunk, #f2f2ef); color: var(--color-ink, #16181b); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-pair p { margin: 0; } .ds-pair-label { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pair-code { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 12px; font-family: var(--font-code, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pair-code span { white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pair-valid { font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-ink-2, #5c6066); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Days / Months / Years: a track pill of 48px options; the chosen one is a white pill with ink text.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--color-track, #e2e2de); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-seg-opt { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-3, #4a4e54); font: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-opt[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--color-track, #e2e2de); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #16181b); } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px var(--color-focus, #1f5a41); }

components.name: Photo Grid
components.description: Signature. A group heading with its count, then rows of 6px-radius square tiles that fill the width, 6px apart. Mouse hover greys the photo, lifts the tile with shadow-raised and shows the select circle.
components.html:
3 November

components.name: Row Menu
components.description: A row's ⋯ menu: a white popover with shadow-raised, 48px items, the last after a hairline. Delete is ink because it goes to Trash; an unavailable item stays focusable and a reason line says why.
components.html: Move or delete what is in it first.
components.css: .ds-menu { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: max-content; min-width: 12rem; max-width: 18rem; padding: 4px 0; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d5d6d2); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(22 24 27 / 6%), 0 4px 12px rgb(22 24 27 / 5%); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-menu-item { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--color-ink, #16181b); font: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { background: var(--color-surface-sunk, #f2f2ef); } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, #1f5a41); } .ds-menu-last { margin-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e4e0); } .ds-menu-item[aria-disabled='true'] { color: var(--color-ink-2, #5c6066); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-menu-why { margin: 0; padding: 0 16px 8px; color: var(--color-ink-2, #5c6066); font-size: 15px; }

narrative.overview:
The frame exists to answer one question first and truthfully: are my photos safe? Everything else is quiet: a warm off-white ground, white rounded cards, deep ink text, line icons, and a single green that is spent only on safety and the primary action. Status is never buried in settings; it leads every main screen as the safety banner.

Density is low and targets are large, built for less confident, older users as much as for households leaving paid clouds. Surfaces are flat; meaning is carried by colour family, material change and words, never by decoration. Motion is short and quiet and disappears under reduced motion.

Before a browser is unlocked (setup, unlock, forgot password, connect, reset) the same world speaks as an unhurried conversation: one centred column, the product mark, one h1, one sentence of why, one question, one green button. There is no banner and no nav, and nothing is timed.
keyCharacteristics: One green, one amber, one red, each with a single meaning.
The safety banner changes material with the box's truth.
Icon plus words, always; never colour alone.
48px minimum targets, a visible two-ring focus, WCAG 2.2 AA.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means "safe" or "this is the primary action". Never use it decoratively, for categories or for brand flourish. One approved exception (owner, 2026-11-03): the storage meter fill is green, because the space it measures holds the photos the box is keeping safe. Green stays off every other meter, chart and category. Progress is not safety: the upload progress fill is `ink-3`, never green, because a file on its way is not safe yet. Second approved exception (owner, 2026-11-04): the album move confirm's arrow and Moving to row are green, because they show where the primary green Move button sends the photos. Green stays off other destinations, selections and highlights.

rules.name: The One Meaning Per Hue Rule
rules.body: Amber is attention (paused, almost full, unreachable) and nothing else. Red is permanent deletion and nothing else; moving to Trash is not red. No hue marks a category: file type chips are neutral (`surface-sunk` with an `ink-3` label), not a red PDF or a blue DOC (M2 Task 16 ruling, 2026-11-04, over the canvas's tinted chips); the type is told by its letters.

rules.name: The Reversible Is Ink Rule
rules.body: (Owner, 2026-11-04.) Move to Trash can be undone for 30 days, so its button is dark ink (`button--ink`), never red. Red appears only where something can't be undone: red words on a quiet white button where the choice is offered (Delete forever on a row, Empty Trash), and a red fill only on the final confirm. A red fill never appears outside that second question.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status carries an icon and words with its colour. The active tab adds a shape (pill) to its colour; the attention dot is paired with the accessible name "Box, needs attention".

rules.name: The 17 Rule
rules.body: Body text is 17px and is never set smaller for density. Text must scale to 200% with no sideways scroll at 320px.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by tone, not by shadow. Introduce `shadow-raised` only for a surface that genuinely floats (a dialog, a sheet, a row menu, the sticky select bar, the scrubber's pill) or as a hover response on a photo tile; never for a card at rest.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Inter sets every word. One deliberate, scoped exception (owner, M2 Task 12): the pairing code is set in IBM Plex Mono so I, l and 1, and 0 and O, can't be confused when a person reads it off one screen and types it into another. The mono face is for codes a person must copy character by character; it is never a label, heading or decorative voice. The code's input field stays in Inter, with tabular figures and 0.04em tracking.

rules.name: The Every Photo Under Its Heading Rule
rules.body: Photos are read as days (or months, or years), each under a heading with its count, newest first; Months and Years show every photo, only smaller, and nothing is curated or hidden. The whole grid is one tab stop: ← → follow reading order, ↑ ↓ keep the nearest column, Home and End go to the ends of the row, Ctrl (or Cmd) with Home or End to the ends of the library, Page Up and Page Down a screen at a time. The tile holding the tab stop is always rendered.

dos: Do use token names from tokens.css, never raw values; a new value needs owner approval and a DESIGN.md update.
Do lead every main screen with the safety banner, and pair every status colour with an icon and words.
Do keep every interactive target at least 48px (--target-min) and keep the focus ring visible.
Do set dynamic values (meter widths, positions) through the CSSOM (el.style.setProperty); the CSP is style-src 'self'.
Do keep line icons at 2px stroke with rounded joins, aria-hidden beside a visible word.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion: durations drop to 0.
Do give each entry page one h1, one question and one primary button, with the step line ("Step n of 5") at the end of the action row.
Do tie every hint and error to its field, and keep errors until the field changes.
Do set codes a person must copy character by character in --font-code; everything else in Inter.
Do keep photos at 6px radius (rounded.xs) and cards at 14 or 18px; a photo is not a card.
Do keep visible words on the viewer's Previous and Next.
Do make the photo grid one tab stop, with arrows, Home, End and Page Up / Page Down inside it.
Do use the ink button for Move to Trash, and put red only on permanent deletion: red words where it is offered, a red fill only on the final confirm.
Do start every dialog's focus on Cancel, close it on Esc, and return focus to its opener.
Do keep hover-only affordances (the tile lift, the select circle) behind hover: hover, with a keyboard route to the same action.
Do let words win over pictures in a narrow dialog: decorative covers hide under a 22rem container, and names wrap between words.
Do keep file type chips neutral and let their letters tell the type.
Do make the whole name cell the target of a file row, and keep the Size column right-aligned in tabular figures.
Do keep a disabled menu item focusable, with a visible line saying why.
donts: Don't use green for anything but "safe" or the primary action.
Don't show green or the word "safe" while checking, copying or in any attention state.
Don't use red for anything but permanent deletion, or amber for anything but paused, almost full or unreachable.
Don't make Move to Trash, or anything reversible, red.
Don't use inline style attributes or injected <style>; the CSP blocks them.
Don't show the Box attention dot for copying or checking.
Don't let tab labels wrap or shrink body text below 17px.
Don't put the step count, or any other small label, above an h1 as an eyebrow.
Don't use the mono face for labels, headings, numbers in general or decoration.
Don't split a recovery word or a pairing code group across lines.
Don't add time limits, countdowns or auto-dismissing errors to entry pages.
Don't fill progress bars green; progress is ink-3 on track.
Don't say "Safe" for an item unless it is replicated and the backup copy is running; tiles carry no backup badges.
Don't make the select bar sticky at or below 720px, where it would cover tiles.
Don't curate or hide photos in Months or Years; they show every photo, only smaller.
Don't colour file types (a red PDF, a blue DOC); a hue is a meaning, not a category.
Don't set column heads, labels or headings in capitals; only a file type's own letters (PDF, HEIC) are.
